tools.name: list_instruments
tools.description: Lists the instruments GCC Brokers offers (forex pairs, metals, indices, commodities, crypto CFDs, futures, perpetuals), each with its gccbrokers.com page. Filter by category.

language.description: Language for page links and translated text. One of: en, ar, fr, th, tr, fa, id, es, de, ru, vi, ms, zh-CN, ja, ko, hi, pt, sv, no, da, fi, nl, it, pl, uk, tl, zh-TW, bn, ur, ro, bg. Default en.

tools.name: get_instrument
tools.description: Trading specifications for one GCC Brokers instrument as clients trade it on the Standard account: contract size, minimum/maximum lot and lot step, margin, swap long/short and multi-night rollover days, and weekly trading hours in UTC. Accepts names like "EUR/USD", "XAUUSD", "gold", "Nasdaq", "bitcoin".

language.description: Language for page links and translated text. One of: en, ar, fr, th, tr, fa, id, es, de, ru, vi, ms, zh-CN, ja, ko, hi, pt, sv, no, da, fi, nl, it, pl, uk, tl, zh-TW, bn, ur, ro, bg. Default en.

tools.name: get_prices
tools.description: Latest bid and ask quotes for up to 10 GCC Brokers instruments as streamed on the Standard account, with the quote time in UTC. Outside trading hours the last quote before the close is returned and marked as not live.

language.description: Language for page links and translated text. One of: en, ar, fr, th, tr, fa, id, es, de, ru, vi, ms, zh-CN, ja, ko, hi, pt, sv, no, da, fi, nl, it, pl, uk, tl, zh-TW, bn, ur, ro, bg. Default en.

tools.name: get_account_types
tools.description: The GCC Brokers live account types (Standard, Pro, Zero) with minimum deposit, pricing, typical spreads (last month, measured on the platform), commission, leverage and stop-out level, plus the Accounts page FAQ.

language.description: Language for page links and translated text. One of: en, ar, fr, th, tr, fa, id, es, de, ru, vi, ms, zh-CN, ja, ko, hi, pt, sv, no, da, fi, nl, it, pl, uk, tl, zh-TW, bn, ur, ro, bg. Default en.

tools.name: get_company_info
tools.description: Who GCC Brokers is: the licensed entity, regulator and licence number (with the public register to verify it), the other companies behind the brand, the Dubai representative office, client protections and their limits, and contact pages.

tools.name: get_economic_calendar
tools.description: Scheduled macroeconomic releases (CPI, payrolls, central-bank decisions, PMIs…) with time in UTC, currency, forecast, previous and actual values. Defaults to the next 7 days at medium and high importance.

to.description: Last day (UTC), inclusive, YYYY-MM-DD. Default from + 6 days.

tools.name: list_insights
tools.description: Market analysis articles published by GCC Brokers, newest first, with title, summary, date and link. Optionally filter by words in the title or summary.

query.description: Words that must all appear in the title or summary, e.g. "gold fed".
